name: Waning
description: Full moons losing their light: a disc with a second disc swung across it, the shadow landing on a different quarter each cell.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 86%; height: 86%; margin: 7%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at @pick(84%, 16%, 50%, 50%) @pick(50%, 50%, 84%, 16%), transparent 52%, #000 52%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at @pick(84%, 16%, 50%, 50%) @pick(50%, 50%, 84%, 16%), transparent 52%, #000 52%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
